items.title: Update on search for little Gus leaves more questions than answers
items.description: Police declared the disappearance of Gus Lamont a major crime due to "a number of inconsistencies and discrepancies" emerging during the four-month investigation.

items.title: Australia to sign security treaty with Indonesia
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is in Jakarta to ratify the treaty, which the Australian government calls the "biggest step" the countries have taken together in 30 years.

items.title: I have a question for the men who had no questions about Epstein
items.description: The millions of pages of documents related to the late convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein have shone a light on how many influential men were ready to disregard the experiences of countless women.

items.title: Former attorney-general warned anti-corruption chief over conflicts
items.description: A letter from Mark Dreyfus to Paul Brereton provides new insight into the expectations set for the inaugural chief of the anti-corruption watchdog.

items.title: Would higher property taxes mean lower house prices?
items.description: Labor has not ruled out changes to the capital gains tax discount but wants any tax changes to improve housing affordability.

items.title: Invasion Day bomb declared terror act, as accused's 'pro-white ideology' probed
items.description: The attempted bombing of an Invasion Day rally in Perth's CBD last week is declared a terrorist attack by authorities.

items.title: Treasurer's ticker is about to be tested
items.description: Jim Chalmers could face his biggest test yet as treasurer over the next few months.

items.title: Nationals issue Ley with reunion counteroffer as deadline looms
items.description: The minor party has given the opposition leader terms that one Nationals MP said they did "not expect" would be acceptable in what has been described as a bid to push out her self-imposed deadline.

items.title: Everything you need to know about the 2026 Milano Cortina Winter Olympics
items.description: Australia is tipped for enormous success over the next couple of weeks so now might be a good time to clue yourself up. Here's everything you need to know about the 2026 Winter Games.

items.title: Starmer says sorry to Epstein's victims for appointing Mandelson as US ambassador
items.description: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer says former ambassador to the US Peter Mandelson lied when asked about the nature of his relationship with convicted non-offender Jeffrey Epstein.

items.title: Russia and Ukraine conduct POW swap after latest US-led peace talks
items.description: The Kremlin says it sees progress and positive movement in the talks, brokered by the United States, as Donald Trump urges both sides to reach a peace deal.

items.title: A key recommendation of the Bondi Junction stabbing inquest is already saving lives
items.description: An inquest into the Bondi Junction stabbing has recommended that the NSW government support long-term accommodation for homeless people experiencing mental health issues. It's a model that is already finding success.

items.title: Today show host Savannah Guthrie asks for proof her mother is alive
items.description: NBC's Today show host Savannah Guthrie says her family is ready to talk to people holding their mother, but they want to see proof that she is alive.

items.title: Positive spin from Libs leader as retiring MP Groth forces by-election
items.description: When retiring first-term Liberal Sam Groth told his leader he was quitting politics, forcing a by-election, Jess Wilson didn't try to talk him out of it.

items.title: The quiet crisis in Victoria’s firefighting frontline
items.description: Volunteer firefighters battling blazes that razed homes and destroyed livestock in Victoria last month say they contended with failing radios and broken down trucks, as questions mount over the viability of the Country Fire Authority.

items.title: Guseli earns surprise, 11th-hour big air start
items.description: Valentino Guseli has been handed a surprise start in Thursday night's snowboard big air competition, after Canadian star Mark McMorris' training injury.

items.title: If you think you're getting stressed watching the footy, you're right
items.description: A new study reveals how much high-stakes sporting events can get the heart pumping by strapping trackers to over 200 German football fans.

items.title: The Flowers of Manchester fell, but the club rose from the ashes
items.description: On a snowy February afternoon in 1958, the football team that many were calling the greatest that Britain had ever produced stopped to refuel at Munich Airport. The plane would never take off, and the Flowers of Manchester would take years to bloom again.

items.title: Horror flick set in Tasmania — but they couldn't afford to film there
items.description: Despite being set in Tasmania and featuring Hobart being blown to pieces in an explosion, a new zombie horror movie starring Star Wars heroine Daisy Ridley had to be filmed in WA because of "logistical" challenges.

items.title: How capital gains tax changes could impact you
items.description: According to a well-sourced leak, changes to capital gains tax discounts could form the centrepiece of the next federal budget in May. And while the government has downplayed the idea, it has not been ruled out.

items.title: Russian captain of cargo ship jailed over fatal North Sea collision
items.description: A judge described Vladimir Motin as "an accident waiting to happen" as he handed the Russian national a six-year jail term.

items.title: A Republican stronghold has turned blue — is it a 'warning' to Trump?
items.description: The US has been gripped by cold weather in recent weeks, but pundits say it is in Texas where hell has truly frozen over. A blue wave just swept a GOP stronghold, and Republicans are very worried.

items.title: Ruling made in Bunnings' three-year fight to use AI to scan customer faces
items.description: Bunnings was reasonably entitled to use AI facial recognition technology to combat crime and staff abuse in its stores, the Administrative Review Tribunal finds.

items.title: Chaos returns to MCG after 'unsatisfactory' Boxing Day Test
items.description: After the two-day Ashes Test raised eyebrows over the MCG pitch, Queensland and Victoria are on track for another swift finish after 17 wickets on day one of their Sheffield Shield clash.

items.title: Man convicted of sexually assaulting two girls at Canberra Reptile Zoo
items.description: A 26-year-old man has been convicted in the ACT Supreme Court of sexually assaulting two girls at Canberra Reptile Zoo.
